Both orbit axes follow a drag, without changing orbit radius
Cursor-anchored zoom preserves off-centre projection at near/far scales
Pan follows drag and preserves camera orientation
Resize updates projection without moving camera or pivot
Every value/query pick retains its head and exact coordinate
Unfold preserves and reconnects every head input/value/query route
Universe hides the floor; view switches restore camera and targets
Selection focus follows a piece; changing views safely clears its move arrow
Weight field low/high channel positions remain pickable above the former floor
Original 128 native fixture comparisons still match
All inspector channel, hidden, output and policy sums reconstruct model outputs
Piece identities cover both games; captured bishop is absent, never replaced
Stored weight reports only its real participating perspectives and pieces
Inactive-head inspection stays on the clicked head across positions
Channel identity and perspective survive turn changes; follow-turn is explicit
Selection Back restores exact weight address and piece identity
View switching restores selected head, unit and channel context
Manual guide follows actual arithmetic and ends on a position change
Each inspector type renders a valid explanation string across game phases
Every constant DOM ID reference has a matching template or generated element
